{{FakeMenuButton|image={{RandomConstructImage|size=114px}}|size=114px|buttonSize=114px|styles=float:left;margin-right:10px}}
Construct is unlocked at obelisk 19. The menu allows you to unlock [[Construct#Veins|veins]], build [[Construct#Statues|statues]] for powerful buffs, and build [[Construct#Monuments|monuments]] to unlock new worlds.

{{clear|left}}
==Research==
The '''Research''' tab allows players to unlock new [[Veins]] for specific [[Floors#Zones|zones]], as well as purchasing 2x Vein Spawn Rate for each individual vein.

==Statues==
There are 27 statues. Each of them gives a unique bonus and is designed by a community member. When you build, gild, or platinize a statue, you get it in random order, not sequentially. All statues must be built to begin gilding, and all statues must be gilded to begin platinizing.

==Monuments==
Building specific monument unlocks that world and the floors therein. Building the World 2 monument unlocks floors 43-72, the World 3 monument unlocks floors 73-102 and the World 4 monument unlocks floors 103-132.

=== Recommendations ===
Since [[Update:V2.2.20]], World 3 and World 4 Monuments have some in-game recommended levels: 
* W3
** [[Guides/Platinize_Statues|Plat Statues]]: All 9 of them 
** Challenges: 68 (that's [[Challenges#tabber-Extreme|Extreme 15]])
** [[Pisces]] Star 4
** [[Elixir]] Grade 25
** [[Fuel generator]] 20
* W4: 
** [[Black hole]] 14
** [[Butterfly]] Pet 5 (unlocking requires either Black Hole 12 or [[Storm serpent]] Tribute 1)
** [[Fuel generator]] 30
** Fishing:
*** First 4 Inf Legns  (see [[Legendary]] and [[Infernal]], requires [[Laviathan]] Tribute 2)
*** Tier 2 Tributes 9 (see [[Tribute]])
